Subject: Draft Q4 investor one-pager + OKR heatmap — first pass

Dylan / Neha — attaching a razor-thin first pass of the QBR one-pager and the OKR heatmap. I focused the narrative on: ARR growth cadence, latency/cost ops improvements, and the top three product bets we want to highlight to investors.

High-level asks: please review by EOD tomorrow for two things: 1) any data corrections in the metrics section, and 2) any high-level narrative tweaks (tone/ask).

Attachments: QBR_onepager_v1.pdf, OKR_heatmap_v1.xlsx

Notes on scope: this is a single-page narrative + a slide for OKR heatmap. If we need more slides, say so — but preference is to keep the investor packet compact.

-Marissa

Subject: Re: Draft Q4 investor one-pager + OKR heatmap — first pass

Thanks Marissa — nice concise draft. Quick inline: 
- Metrics row (line "net new ARR") looks like it uses projected bookings, not recognized. Aditya, can you confirm the source?
- Under "Operational wins" can we swap the order so the latency/cost wins sit first (investors ask about unit economics).
- OKR heatmap: the priority coloring is fine but the legend could be clearer for green/yellow thresholds.

I'll collect data points and send an export for the metrics table this afternoon. If we can get a tidy v2 by Wednesday morning, I can route to Tom at Blackrock before our Thurs call.

-Dylan

Subject: Re: Draft Q4 investor one-pager + OKR heatmap — metrics export

Attaching the CSV export from metrics (pulled from analytics pipeline). The ARR line in v1 did indeed come from booking projections — updated recognized ARR numbers are in the attachment.

Attachment: metrics-export.csv

A couple of clarifications: 
- Recognized ARR for Q3 -> Q4 step change includes a one-time enterprise onboarding credit we granted (FYI). We should call that out in a parenthetical to avoid over-emphasizing run-rate growth.
- Latency reduction numbers are 95th percentile improvements post-quantization rollout; I'll include a short note we can paste under "Operational wins".

- Aditya

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft Q4 investor one-pager + OKR heatmap — prioritization notes

Marissa / Dylan — reviewed with the exec team this morning. Two quick edits from leadership: 
1) Move the "cost per token" improvement into the summary bullet — investors care about unit economics up front.
2) Trim the product bets to the top two (Gen Assist + Private Deploy) and include brief KPIs under each (expected ARR impact and adoption milestone).

I also recommend we add a single-line "ask" at the bottom: what we want from investors (network intros, early adopter pilots, optional bridge to the Dedicated sales channel). Keeps the document action-oriented.

If you send updated slides by EOD today I can route to the CEO for a quick pass tomorrow morning.

-Neha
Chief Operating Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Updated one-pager (v2) + OKR heatmap — ready for signoff

Team — attached QBR_onepager_v2.pdf. Changes made per thread: updated ARR to recognized numbers, promoted unit economics into the summary, reduced product bets to Gen Assist and Private Deploy with short KPIs, and added an "Investor ask" line.

Claire — including you here so Horizon IR has the latest language before the investor call. If anything reads incorrectly from your side, flag it and we'll adjust.

Attachments: QBR_onepager_v2.pdf

Please reply with a single-line signoff ("+1" is fine) or highlight any remaining redlines by 5 PM PT. If I don't hear objections, I'll send to the CEO for final read at 9 AM tomorrow.

Thanks —
-Marissa
